cohort: Women older than 18 years who received epidural labor analgesia and could communicate in Thai, at the largest university hospital in Thailand.
finding: Approximately 29.7% of patients who received epidural analgesia underwent cesarean delivery, with maternal age > 27 years, no history of prior vaginal delivery, and neonatal weight > 3270 g being significantly associated factors.
mod_finding: The study found that approximately 29.7% of patients receiving epidural analgesia underwent cesarean delivery, and identified maternal age > 27 years, no history of vaginal delivery, and neonatal weight > 3270 g as factors significantly associated with this mode of birth.
